items.summary: cmake/RXMeshConfig.cmake.in (upstream, untouched by the port) is CUDA-only: find_dependency(CUDAToolkit), CUDA::cusparse/cusolver, no USE_HIP define, no -fgpu-rdc/--hip-link, no hip_compat include dir, no roc::hip* libs; it now also include()s RXMeshApp.cmake whose CUDA branch needs numeric CUDA archs. A HIP install-and-find_package consumer does not work; in-tree and FetchContent/add_subdirectory consumers do. Pre-existing since the first port; found in the moat-fix-73 review.
